title: Duff in Beach
statementMd:
While Duff was resting in the beach, she accidentally found a strange array $*b*_{0}, *b*_{1}, ..., *b*_{*l* - 1}$ consisting of $*l*$ positive integers. This array was strange because it was extremely long, but there was another (maybe shorter) array, $*a*_{0}, ..., *a*_{*n* - 1}$ that $*b*$ can be build from $*a*$ with formula: $*b*_{*i*} = *a*_{*i* *mod* *n*}$ where $*a* *mod* *b*$ denoted the remainder of dividing $*a*$ by $*b*$.

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/a139e8348cb51506750b02a60b0b82324e08b748.png)

Duff is so curious, she wants to know the number of subsequences of $*b*$ like $*b*_{*i*_{1}}, *b*_{*i*_{2}}, ..., *b*_{*i*_{*x*}}$ ($0 ≤ *i*_{1} < *i*_{2} < ... < *i*_{*x*} < *l*$), such that:

- $1 ≤ *x* ≤ *k*$
- For each $1 ≤ *j* ≤ *x* - 1$, ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/8049e70898b1d8579ee1e94f4c68483c301ddfc5.png)
- For each $1 ≤ *j* ≤ *x* - 1$, $*b*_{*i*_{*j*}} ≤ *b*_{*i*_{*j* + 1}}$. i.e this subsequence is non-decreasing.

Since this number can be very large, she want to know it modulo $10^{9} + 7$.

Duff is not a programmer, and Malek is unavailable at the moment. So she asked for your help. Please tell her this number.

## Input

The first line of input contains three integers, $*n*, *l*$ and $*k*$ ($1 ≤ *n*, *k*$, $*n* × *k* ≤ 10^{6}$ and $1 ≤ *l* ≤ 10^{18}$).

The second line contains $*n*$ space separated integers, $*a*_{0}, *a*_{1}, ..., *a*_{*n* - 1}$ ($1 ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{9}$ for each $0 ≤ *i* ≤ *n* - 1$).

## Output

Print the answer modulo $1 000 000 007$ in one line.

## Note

In the first sample case, ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/d9d8fe92937aeef2bcddb9d213e5587f0f950087.png). So all such sequences are: ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/54d7dd513b50dae3415992b37dcf6f8ff2f24a73.png), ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/fcd7414fd5b0b1459adc9dafca95e6d5a23b0d7d.png), ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/f6d2e0d0317c10a3c5213068fb1d1e1f53ff26eb.png), ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/8f6627cad3dd113f47d84a1226f30fe423939757.png), ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/c6db71d99107f752b5caa1ba7e44af1d2302e5db.png), ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/a06ffb7bf9126fd634a790703c0bbfda00c60aa1.png), ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/b086d545b6c80640ea8558920709e3c51ba3bf43.png), ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/661b7811fccac48a9e96733bc99c3dfec93ad6d7.png), ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/8756896f0d00888771e69f1a9ccddeee19d4a9ab.png) and ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/e771f8119b1b8218c875759aa03e38312514c9a2.png).
statementZhMd:
Duff 在海滩上休息时，偶然发现了一个由 $*l*$ 个正整数组成的奇怪数组 $*b*_{0}, *b*_{1}, ..., *b*_{*l* - 1}$。这个数组之所以奇怪，是因为它非常长，但存在另一个（可能更短的）数组 $*a*_{0}, ..., *a*_{*n* - 1}$，使得 $*b*$ 可以通过以下公式由 $*a*$ 构造得到：$*b*_{*i*} = *a*_{*i* *mod* *n*}$，其中 $*a* *mod* *b*$ 表示 $*a*$ 除以 $*b*$ 的余数。

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/a139e8348cb51506750b02a60b0b82324e08b748.png)

Duff 非常好奇，她想知道 $*b*$ 的子序列 $*b*_{*i*_{1}}, *b*_{*i*_{2}}, ..., *b*_{*i*_{*x*}}$（$0 ≤ *i*_{1} < *i*_{2} < ... < *i*_{*x*} < *l*$）中，满足以下条件的子序列数量：

- $1 ≤ *x* ≤ *k*$
- 对于每个 $1 ≤ *j* ≤ *x* - 1$，![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/8049e70898b1d8579ee1e94f4c68483c301ddfc5.png)
- 对于每个 $1 ≤ *j* ≤ *x* - 1$，$*b*_{*i*_{*j*}} ≤ *b*_{*i*_{*j* + 1}}$。也就是说，该子序列是非递减的。

由于这个数量可能非常大，她希望知道其对 $10^{9} + 7$ 取模后的结果。

Duff 不会编程，而 Malek 此刻也无法联系上。因此她向你寻求帮助。请告诉她这个数量。

## 输入格式

输入的第一行包含三个整数 $*n*, *l*$ 和 $*k*$（$1 ≤ *n*, *k*$，$*n* × *k* ≤ 10^{6}$ 且 $1 ≤ *l* ≤ 10^{18}$）。

第二行包含 $*n*$ 个空格分隔的整数 $*a*_{0}, *a*_{1}, ..., *a*_{*n* - 1}$（对于每个 $0 ≤ *i* ≤ *n* - 1$，都有 $1 ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{9}$）。

## 输出格式

在一行中输出答案对 $1 000 000 007$ 取模后的结果。

## 说明

在第一个样例中，![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/d9d8fe92937aeef2bcddb9d213e5587f0f950087.png)。因此，所有满足条件的序列为：![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/54d7dd513b50dae3415992b37dcf6f8ff2f24a73.png)、![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/fcd7414fd5b0b1459adc9dafca95e6d5a23b0d7d.png)、![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/f6d2e0d0317c10a3c5213068fb1d1e1f53ff26eb.png)、![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/8f6627cad3dd113f47d84a1226f30fe423939757.png)、![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/c6db71d99107f752b5caa1ba7e44af1d2302e5db.png)、![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/a06ffb7bf9126fd634a790703c0bbfda00c60aa1.png)、![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/b086d545b6c80640ea8558920709e3c51ba3bf43.png)、![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/661b7811fccac48a9e96733bc99c3dfec93ad6d7.png)、![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/8756896f0d00888771e69f1a9ccddeee19d4a9ab.png) 和 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/e771f8119b1b8218c875759aa03e38312514c9a2.png)。
